name: 国考
description: 中央机关及其直属机构考试录用公务员关键时间节点，包括公告、报名、资格审查、缴费、准考证、笔试和成绩查询。

events.name: 2026年度国考公告发布
events.name_en: 2026 China National Civil Service Exam Announcement
events.description: 中央机关及其直属机构 2026 年度考试录用公务员公告发布。
events.description_en: Announcement of the 2026 civil service recruitment by central government agencies and their directly affiliated institutions.

events.name: 2026年度国考报名开始
events.name_en: 2026 China National Civil Service Exam Registration Opens
events.description: 考生可登录专题网站提交报考申请。
events.description_en: Candidates may submit applications on the dedicated exam website.

events.name: 2026年度国考报名截止

events.description: 报名申请提交截止，逾期不再受理。

events.name: 2026年度国考资格审查截止
events.name_en: 2026 China National Civil Service Exam Qualification Review Deadline
events.description: 招录机关资格审查截止。
events.description_en: Deadline for qualification review by recruiting agencies.

events.name: 2026年度国考缴费确认截止
events.name_en: 2026 China National Civil Service Exam Payment Confirmation Deadline
events.description: 通过资格审查的考生完成网上报名确认并缴费。
events.description_en: Candidates who passed qualification review complete online confirmation and payment.

events.name: 2026年度国考准考证打印
events.name_en: 2026 China National Civil Service Exam Admission Ticket Release

events.name: 2026年度国考公共科目笔试
events.name_en: 2026 China National Civil Service Exam Public Subjects Written Exam
events.description: 中央机关及其直属机构考试录用公务员公共科目笔试。
events.description_en: Public subjects written exam of the national civil service recruitment.

events.name: 2026年度国考笔试成绩查询
events.name_en: 2026 China National Civil Service Exam Written Exam Results Release
events.description: 笔试成绩和合格分数线预计于 2026 年 1 月公布，具体以专题网站为准。
events.description_en: Written exam results and qualifying scores are expected in January 2026; follow the dedicated exam website.
